name: Codex HQX Smooth Borders Shader
instruction: Update res://assets/shaders/map3d.gdshader to apply HQX-style border smoothing for the map texture. Add uniforms threshold (0.1), aa_scale (17.6), and base_line_thickness (0.38197), include the diagonal line blending function, and in fragment sample subview_image with texelFetch to compute the smoothed color before assigning ALBEDO. In res://scenes/main.tscn, set those three shader parameters on the MeshInstance3D ShaderMaterial while keeping subview_image assigned to res://assets/textures/ProvinceMap.bmp.
